citation.authors: Barouqa M, Ashfaq MA, Jiang KJ et al

cited_by.title: Low haemoglobin, low or high white cells: causes, thresholds and pregnancy

record.population: 122 healthy adults with confirmed Duffy-null [Fy(a-b-)] phenotype, drawn from 1,695 adults with a blood count and red cell phenotyping at one institution (2020 to 2026)
record.finding: Median neutrophil count was 1.45 against 4.45 x10^3 per microlitre in the institution's reference. The Duffy-null 95% reference interval for neutrophils was 1.01 to 4.34 x10^3 per microlitre, with the lower bound below the standard neutropenia cut-off. The authors support Duffy-null-specific ranges.
record.note: Single institution (University of South Alabama, US). Participants selected by Duffy status.
